author: Nicholas II
title: Дневник Николая II, 1917 год (diary of Nicholas II for 1917)
notes: An online transcription of the emperor's own diary for 1917, with the editor's expansions of his abbreviations in square brackets. The weakness is real and is stated rather than hidden: the site does not say which printed edition it transcribes, so the wording used in this pack was confirmed against a second, independent transcription (doc20vek.ru) before being quoted. Cited for what Nicholas wrote on the day, which is what a diary is evidence of.
